stem.text: A lift is supported by two steel cables, each of length $10\,\text{m}$ and diameter $0.5\,\text{cm}$.

stem.alt: Diagram of a lift hanging from two steel cables, with a dimension of 10 m from the top support to the lift, a man standing inside the lift, and the note NOT TO SCALE.

stem.text: The cables extend by $1\,\text{mm}$ when a man of mass $80\,\text{kg}$ steps into the lift.
